### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async(page)=>{await page.goto('http://localhost:8792');await page.route('https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies**',async route=>{await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,1200));await route.fulfill({json:{}})});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search Trials',exact:false}).click();const loading=await page.getByRole('status').innerText();await page.getByRole('alert').waitFor();const error=await page.getByRole('alert').innerText();const errorCards=await page.getByRole('link',{name:'View Trial',exact:true}).count();await page.unroute('https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies**');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Try again',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText(/\d+ trials found/).waitFor({timeout:60000});const retryCount=await page.getByRole('link',{name:'View Trial',exact:true}).count();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Show filters',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('spinbutton',{name:'Your Age'}).fill('0');await page.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Location'}).selectOption('United States');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'GBM',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Phase 3',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search Trials',exact:false}).click();await page.getByText('No trials found',{exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:60000});return {loading,error,errorCards,retryCount,emptyCards:await page.getByRole('link',{name:'View Trial',exact:true}).count(),emptyState:await page.getByRole('status').innerText()};})(page);
```
